@@U00073@@
It's why I approve your method:
tagging along to prod and prick him on,
as any self-respecting devil must.

@@U00074@@
(To the ARCHANGELS.)

@@U00075@@
As for you, God’s true and faithful sons,
rejoice in the world’s endless living beauty!
May the power of Becoming
that lives and works eternally,
encompass you in the gracious bonds of love,
and give to the unstable world of seeming
permanence by fixing it in eternal thought.

@@U00076@@
(The heavens close, the ARCHANGELS disperse.)

@@U00078@@
I enjoy seeing the old boy now and again,
taking good care to stay on friendly terms.
It’s really quite decent of so grand a lord
to chat with the Devil in such a human fashion.

@@U00080@@
A narrow, high-vaulted Gothic Chamber.
浮士德 sits restlessly at the desk in his armchair.

@@U00082@@
Here I stand!
A fool!
I who have studied and crammed Philosophy,
Law, and Medicine, and even, oh, God! Theology,
from end to bitter end!
And what has it got me?
Nothing.
translation:
@@U00073@@
这就是为什么我批准你的方法：
跟着刺激并刺伤他，
正如任何有自尊心的魔鬼所必须的那样。

@@U00074@@
（致大天使们。）

@@U00075@@
至于你们，上帝真实而忠实的儿子们，
为世界无尽的生命之美而欣喜！
愿成为的力量
永远存在和工作，
用仁慈的爱的纽带包围你，
并给予看似不稳定的世界
通过将其固定在永恒的思想中来实现永久性。

@@U00076@@
（天堂关闭，大天使们散去。）

@@U00078@@
我很高兴时不时地见到这个老男孩，
小心保持友好关系。
这么大的领主真是太有面子了
以如此人类的方式与魔鬼交谈。

@@U00080@@
一个狭窄、高拱形的哥特式房间。
浮士德不安地坐在书桌前的扶手椅上。

@@U00082@@
我站在这里！
一个傻瓜！
我这个学过哲学、死记硬背过的人，
法律、医学，甚至，哦，上帝！神学，
从最后到痛苦的结局！
它给我带来了什么？
没有什么。
